Head_and_Face: Head is long and flat with slight stop and moderate length square muzzle.
Ears are small, rose-shaped (folded back), and set high.
Eyes are dark and alert.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is rough, hard, wiry, and dense ranging from grey, brindle, red, black, white, to wheaten.
Body is muscular and powerful with deep chest of enormous proportions.
Tallest of all dog breeds.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight, heavy-boned, and muscular with round compact feet.
Tail is long, slightly curved, and well-covered with hair.
Neck is long and muscular with slight arch.

Head_and_Face: Head is long and narrow with flat skull and minimal stop.
Ears are small, thin, and rose-shaped (folded back).
Eyes are large, dark, oval, and expressive with alert gaze.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is short, fine, glossy, and close-lying ranging from solid grey, black, red, fawn, cream, blue, to white.
Body is extremely slender and elegant with deep narrow chest and visible abdominal tuck-up, of very small toy-sighthound proportions and remarkably lightweight build.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are extremely long, straight, and fine-boned with narrow hare feet.
Tail is long, thin, tapering, and carried low with slight curve.
Skin is thin and visible through coat.

Head_and_Face: Head is long and lean with flat skull and minimal stop.
Ears are small, thin, and rose-shaped (folded back against neck).
Eyes are large, oval, dark, and alert with keen expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is short, smooth, dense, and close-lying ranging from any color or combination.
Body is slender and athletic with deep narrow chest, pronounced abdominal tuck-up, and arched loin, of medium sighthound proportions with lean lightweight build.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are long, straight, and muscular with oval compact feet.
Tail is long, tapering, and carried low with slight upward curve.
Gait is free, low, smooth, and ground-covering with exceptional acceleration.

Head_and_Face: Head is long and narrow with flat skull and minimal stop.
Large erect ears, wide at base and pointed, carried upright and mobile.
Eyes are amber-colored, small, and obliquely set creating alert expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is short and smooth or longer and wiry depending on variety.
Coloration ranges from red, white, red-and-white, or white with red markings.

Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are long, straight, and fine-boned with oval feet.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and wedge-shaped with moderate stop and medium-length square muzzle.
Ears are small, erect, pointed, and set high on head.
Eyes are dark brown, medium-sized, and alert.
Body_and_Plumage: Double-layered coat: dense soft undercoat with coarse straight outer coat creating weather-resistant texture.
Uniform grey with darker tips: black guard hairs over lighter grey undercoat creating silver-grey appearance.
Body is compact and well-balanced with deep chest of medium spitz-dog proportions.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight and sturdy with oval compact feet.
Tail is tightly curled and heavily coated, carried over back.
Gait is free, effortless, and ground-covering.

Head_and_Face: Head is large and domed with moderate stop and deep square muzzle.
Ears are very long, pendulous, set low, and heavily folded.
Eyes are dark or hazel, deep-set, with solemn expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Double-layered coat: long, coarse, shaggy outer coat of substantial length over dense oily waterproof undercoat.

Body is powerful and substantial with deep chest of large hound proportions.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight, heavy-boned, with large webbed feet adapted for swimming.
Tail is long, slightly curved, and well-feathered, carried saber-like.
Webbed feet and oily coat distinguish as water-hunting breed.

Head_and_Face: Head is long and narrow with slight dome and minimal stop.

Body_and_Plumage: Coat is smooth and silky with feathering on legs, thighs, and ears in feathered variety.

Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are long, straight, and fine-boned with hare feet.

Head_and_Face: Head is long and broad with flat skull and slight stop.

Head_and_Face: Head is long and aristocratic with slight dome and moderate stop.
